items.html: And there is another reason, with the above: that in the First Temple, the upper Ima, called the upper Hey, expanded until the second Hod of ZA; and indeed, Malchut would suckle from her, for there is the place of Malchut. But in the Second Temple, Bina expanded only until the first Hod of ZA alone, which is the aspect of the present Gevura, as above.
